sheet.description: Play in sync with friends, each on their own computer. Everyone needs an account on this Jellyfin server ({{server}}) and can join from Orphyn or from the Jellyfin web app.
sheet.createHint: What you are playing is shared as soon as the room is open.
sheet.empty: No room yet. Create one and your friends will see it here.
sheet.loadFailed: The rooms could not be loaded.
sheet.noAccess: Your account is not allowed to use SyncPlay on this server. An administrator can allow it in the user's settings on the server.
sheet.leaveHint: Playback goes on here, on its own.
sheet.nothing: Nothing is playing yet. Start a film or some music: everyone follows.

notice.itemUnavailable: This item is not in your libraries. The room goes on without you until the next one.
notice.libraryDenied: Not everyone in the room can play this item.
notice.createDenied: Your account cannot create a room on this server.
notice.error: The server could not be reached for SyncPlay.
